main_measure.name: mean signed excess 2-day return (Sunday close to Tuesday close) over Sunday cases, before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and slope t >= 2); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: slope of signed excess 2-day return on s20/s60 (recomputed from closes)

decided_by: Main mean positive with t >= 2 and the s20/s60 slope positive with t >= 2.
reading: Cases are Sunday (UTC start) bars with nonzero forecast and a close two bars later in the same window, the coin's mean 2-day return is pooled over a 0,2,4,... grid of all its windows, s20/s60 uses within-window daily returns (std ddof 1, cases without 60 returns left out of the regression), and the plan's 300-case minimum is applied as 'not observable'.
